procedure_name: PM SVANidhi Micro-Credit Loan for Street Vendors
summary: Collateral-free working capital loan of ₹10,000, ₹20,000, and ₹50,000 with 7% interest subsidy for street vendors.

steps.title: Confirm street vending credentials
steps.description: Vendor must hold Certificate of Vending or Letter of Recommendation (LoR) from urban local body.

steps.title: Apply on PM SVANidhi portal
steps.description: Select preferred lending bank, input mobile number linked to Aadhaar, and loan amount tier.

steps.title: Bank digital appraisal
steps.description: Bank verifies credit history; no physical collateral or guarantor required.

steps.title: Loan disbursement to savings account
steps.description: Loan credited directly into bank account; vendor receives digital QR code for digital transaction cashbacks.

steps.title: 7% interest subsidy payout
steps.description: Interest subsidy of 7% credited quarterly into bank account upon timely monthly repayment.
